claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
All times in the Sunday, April 12 (Round 4) schedule are ET.
Featured Groups coverage runs from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters App, ESPN App.
Amen Corner coverage runs from 11:15 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters App.
Early Coverage runs from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Main Broadcast (TV) runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Final Round Streaming runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+, CBSSports.com.
